LESSON: LENGTH

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Measurement
Topic 2.1: Length

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Length. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LOOK AND LEARN

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-058.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 58]]

From your pupil's book (page 58)

MEASUREMENT LENGTH Week 8 Lesson 4 Measuring length Activity What is the length of the teacher’s table?

The length of the teacher’s table is ____ pencils

Measure Number of pencils Length of the longer side of mathematics textbook Shorter side of teacher’s table Shorter side of the door

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-121.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 121]]

From your pupil's book (page 121)

MEASUREMENT LENGTH Week 8 Lesson 2 Measuring length Activity Measure the length of the chalkboard

The length of the chalkboard is ____ sticks

Number of sticks What is the length of the? Blue White Red Longer side of classroom wall Shorter side of classroom wall

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-173.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 173]]

From your pupil's book (page 173)

MEASUREMENT LENGTH Week 6 Lesson 2 Measuring length

Activity Make a 1 -metre stick using a metre rule

Measure the length of the chalkboard using a 1 - metre stick. The length of the chalkboard is ___ 1 - metre sticks. The length of the chalkboard is ___ metres

Work to do Use your 1-metre stick to measure, Use a 1-metre stick to Number of Metres measure; 1-metre sticks Length of classroom window Length of the longer side of the classroom 161

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Length means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Length.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Length
2. Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
3. Learning materials: Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2
4. Revise with the quiz now.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
